entities.summary: Ali Pirzad-Amoli, better known by his stage name A-Lee, is a Norwegian pop recording artist, rapper, singer, songwriter and executive producer. A-Lee is the co-founder and CEO of his own record label EE Records and with BMG Chrysalis as a songwriter.
